title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.06328v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. translated_title: EvoCodeAgent：基于架构-代码协同演化与经验引导修复的项目级代码生成
translated_abstract: 项目级代码生成旨在从高层次需求自动合成完整的软件仓库，生成具有结构良好模块和一致跨文件依赖关系的连贯多文件系统。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在规范理解和代码合成方面具有强大能力，但现有方法仍存在几个关键局限性。首先，许多方法依赖静态架构设计，无法在迭代生成过程中进行调整，导致架构与实现之间的偏差日益扩大。其次，它们缺乏在迭代之间积累和复用经验的机制，导致错误反复出现且效率降低。第三，它们通常依赖独立的基于LLM的中间产物评估，这种方式在长上下文推理下透明度有限且可能不可靠。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了E……
tldr: 提出EvoCodeAgent，通过架构-代码协同演化和经验引导修复两大机制实现项目级代码生成，解决了静态架构无法适应迭代生成、跨迭代经验无法积累复用、以及独立LLM评估不可靠等关键问题。
en_tdlr: EvoCodeAgent achieves project-level code generation through architecture-code co-evolution and experience-guided repair, addressing static architecture inflexibility, lack of cross-iteration experience accumulation, and unreliable standalone LLM-based evaluation.
